study_identification_part.si4_title: Neuroanatomical heterogeneity and homogeneity in individuals at clinical high risk for psychosis

answer: ENIGMA CHR-P structural MRI multi-site dataset (29 sites; 1579 CHR-P, 1243 HC)
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single pooled structural MRI dataset from the ENIGMA CHR-P consortium covering cortical surface area/thickness, subcortical volume, and ICV across 29 sites
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset amalgamated clinical and neuroimaging data from 29 sites, comprising 1579 individuals meeting CHR-P criteria ... and 1243 HC participants."

answer.ENIGMA CHR-P structural MRI dataset: normative PBSI reference (HC) and heterogeneity analyses contrasting CHR-P vs HC and transition subgroups

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy controls provide the normative reference for PBSI z-scores; CHR-P participants are compared against HC and stratified by transition/subgroup status for variability ratio and PBSI analyses
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: “First, to assess the extent of within-diagnosis similarity or divergence ... using a normative modelling approach ... correlated with the corresponding profiles of the members of the HC group … CHR-P participants who transitioned … were not included in the latter investigation (eFig. 1).”

dc3_number_of_healthy_control.detail: Healthy controls (overall normative reference) N=1243; no separate training/test split described for the normative PBSI reference
dc3_number_of_healthy_control.supporting_text: "The ENIGMA CHR-P dataset ... comprising 1579 individuals ... and 1243 HC participants."

dc4_age_info.detail: Overall HC age mean 22.32 years, SD 4.96; other distributional stats and any training split not reported

dc5_sex_info.detail: HC group sex counts 687 male / 556 female (44.7% female, 55.3% male); no train/test split reported
